name: TLD registry WHOIS servers (port 43; server per TLD from the IANA root zone database)
operator: The registry (TLD manager) of each top-level domain, e.g. the Coordination Center for TLD RU (whois.tcinet.ru), CNNIC (whois.cnnic.cn), NIC.br (whois.registro.br)
tier_rationale: Internet registries are trusted (A8 BR2); P343 chair rationale: 'Default module tier trusted (IANA and registries), terms open.' Virtual provider: port-43 servers are named per TLD by the IANA root zone database at run time, never HTTP hosts.

reliability.justification: Authoritative registry data, parsed conservatively from per-registry WHOIS text layouts (allow-listed fields only).

port43.title: Registry WHOIS on port 43 (one query line per domain, at most one referral hop)

terms.quote: Registry WHOIS terms are respected (per-query only, no bulk or marketing use).

port43.notes: Quote: binding council text (P343 FC3); research record C0786 'Registry WHOIS terms of use (no bulk queries, no marketing use)'. Per-query lookups only, never lists or loops, raw text never republished (registro.br terms forbid distribution). Port 43 goes only through the core whois43 helper on the socket connector (10 s timeout, 64 KB cap, one referral hop; UNAVAILABLE with a proxy or when 43/tcp is blocked) - not in this build (core request of batch p2-G01-4), so the source reports UNAVAILABLE 'offline' until it lands.

notes: Owned by batch p2-G01-4 (P343 module whois_fallback). Politeness asked of the core whois43 helper: 3 s between queries to one server, at most 200 queries per server and day (registro.br and CNNIC throttle per IP).
